claims.text: The single bounded producer emits an unchecked D5 candidate or reports projection_kills_one. Only a separate independent D5 checker with nonzero constant and fresh exact zero count establishes LFD at least six.

aa.not_applicable_reason: One exact named input, no timing comparison.

positive.not_applicable_reason: The D5 checker previously accepted a separate nontrivial n8 evaluation-map fixture; this producer run has no planted lower-bound target.

decision_rule.text: Record native candidate as candidate_unchecked with digest and bytes, killed projection as projection_kills_one, and failure/timeout as failed. A candidate becomes an LFD-six lower bound only after a separate independent D5 checker accepts nonzero constant and the fresh exact count is zero.
decision_rule.threshold: Native producer recognized exit after fresh exact count zero; separate accepted D5 nonmembership for any LFD-six inference.

placement.checkpoint_detail: No checkpoint, restore or automatic retry. Retain write-once local transcripts and any candidate; both frontier locks free.

inadmissible: Calling a native candidate certified before independent D5 checking.
Calling projection_kills_one a checked W5 membership derivation.
Replacing the fixed named random00 input or D4 seed after freeze.
Retrying, restoring or bypassing resource, budget, deadline, lock or published-revision gates.
invalidation_rules: Any source, binary, seed, rank or checker hash mismatch prevents execution.
A fresh exact count other than zero stops before the producer.
A failed independent D5 checker prevents a lower-bound claim.
A killed projection, timeout, OOM, missing certificate or failed run leaves W5 nonmembership unknown.

links.launch_gate: No active Semaev native/EKS job; exact published GitHub revision; free exclusive locks; pinned D4 seed and worker; 96 GiB child cap plus 8 GiB reserve; 45.16 GB maximum certificate plus 4 GiB disk reserve; fresh shared daily/monthly budget readback with USD 20 reservation; full 8h15m before 2026-11-10 23:30 UTC; one total attempt, no retry.

literature.claim: For a zero-solution Boolean system, an independently checked D5 quotient with nonzero constant proves LFD at least six and every F4 run reaches degree at least six.
The accepted n47 D4 kernel equals W4 under the audited direct fixed-point algorithm and matching rank calculation; this is source-and-receipt evidence, not a primal derivation certificate.
